caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile object, possibly a rug or mat, composed of various colors and patterns. The outermost border features a thick, braided pattern in alternating sections of red, blue, and a neutral color. Inside the braided border is a narrower, dark brown border, followed by a pattern dominated by alternating horizontal and curving lines in shades of brown, cream, blue, red, and pink. Toward the center-right of the textile, there is a prominent square or diamond-shaped motif outlined in red, subdivided diagonally into four segments with dark blue, black, white, and light brown colors. Around this motif, intersecting curved and straight lines, primarily in blue and red, create oval and wedge shapes in the upper left, lower left, and lower right corners, filled with off-white, tan, brown, and occasional yellow or blue highlights. The artist's signature, "Charles Goodwin," appears in the lower right corner outside the textile drawing.
title: Shaker Shirred Rug
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
